Reviewing pair 1 against the key.

**Pair 1 — not_equivalent.** The key has two substantive components: (a) the custodian arrangement (Norrell Bay Trust & Custody, N.A. for substantially all accounts, with a limited number of securities-based lending and option accounts at Corvedale Clay Securities, LLC), and (b) the independent accountant performing the annual surprise examination (Aldwick Brennan LLP). The analyst's answer captures only the two custodian names and omits Aldwick Brennan LLP and the surprise examination entirely. That is a missing required element, not merely a difference in wording or level of detail. (The dropped allocation detail — "substantially all" vs. "a limited number" — is secondary, but it also flattens which custodian holds what.)

pairs.note: Answer lists only the two custodians (Norrell Bay Trust & Custody, N.A. and Corvedale Clay Securities, LLC) and omits a required element of the key: Aldwick Brennan LLP as the firm performing the annual surprise examination. It also drops the allocation detail (substantially all accounts vs. a limited number of securities-based lending and option accounts), though the missing surprise-examination accountant is the controlling defect.
